en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a woman seated in an ornate armchair by a tiled fireplace in an elegant, richly decorated room. She is reading a book and has a shawl over her lap. Decorative objects such as candlesticks, a clock or figurine, and patterned wallpaper and carpets are visible. At the bottom of the postcard is printed German text identifying her as Henny Porten and indicating the scene is in her home.
